JAINA_POWER_HEARTHSTONE_FORM_POWER.title: Hearthstone Form
JAINA_POWER_HEARTHSTONE_FORM_POWER.descr:
All your cards have [gold]Retain[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
Block no longer disappears at the start of your turn.
When you draw a Status card, draw an extra card.
Starting next turn, gain 10 Energy each turn, and draw 1 card instead of 5 at the start of your turn.
Cards drawn after your hand is full are burned.
When your Draw Pile and Discard Pile are empty, enter [gold]Fatigue[/gold].
JAINA_POWER_HEARTHSTONE_FORM_POWER.smart: All cards Retain + Exhaust; Status draws trigger extra draws; 10 Energy per turn; turn-start draw 5 becomes 1; full-hand draws burn; empty piles cause Fatigue.
